title: Household Parking Allowance — Community Rules & Site Care Addendum to the Home-Site Lease
content:
For the monthly vehicle permit fee of Community Rules & Site Care, the number of registered vehicles a site holds permit-free follows the household registered on the Home-Site Lease:

(a) a household of exactly 1 adult occupant on a single-section home site has one vehicle fewer than the plan's included registered vehicles permit-free — with the 2 included vehicles every plan shows, 1 vehicle;

(b) a household of 3 or more adult occupants on a multi-section home site has one vehicle more than the plan's included registered vehicles permit-free — with 2 included vehicles, 3 vehicles;

(c) every other household has the plan's included registered vehicles permit-free.

The number of adult occupants and the home section — single-section or multi-section — are read from the Home-Site Lease of the site.

## Every combination

| Adult occupants on the Home-Site Lease | Home on the site | Permit-free allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | single-section | one fewer than included: 1 vehicle |
| 1 | multi-section | the plan's included vehicles |
| 2 | single-section | the plan's included vehicles |
| 2 | multi-section | the plan's included vehicles |
| 3 or more | single-section | the plan's included vehicles |
| 3 or more | multi-section | one more than included: 3 vehicles |

## The thresholds on both sides

- 2 adult occupants on a multi-section home site fall short of 3, so (c) applies; 3 adult occupants on the same site reach it, so (b) applies.
- 1 adult occupant on a single-section home site is (a); a second adult occupant on that site moves the household to (c).
- A single adult occupant on a multi-section home site is (c): (a) requires both one adult occupant and a single-section home.
